name: read
description: 读取文件内容，支持文本/图片/视频/PDF/Jupyter notebook/Office 及文档格式（docx/docm/dotx/doc、xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm/xls、pptx/pptm/potx/ppsx、odt/ods/odp/rtf；旧版 .ppt 不支持）。Office 文档会转换为 Markdown 并抽取内嵌图片与视频本体，产物落盘到 .moss/analysis/<文件哈希>/（项目内为 <工作目录>/.moss/analysis，本机模式为全局 ~/.moss/analysis），Markdown 中在对应内容处附上图片/视频的读取路径。视频文件返回基础信息与容器元数据（时长/分辨率/编码，mp4/mov/webm/mkv 等）。支持全量读取（带行号）、精确行范围读取（offset+limit）、indentation 模式（基于缩进提取完整代码块）。支持多文件批量读取。自动检测 UTF-8/GBK 编码，检测 minified 文件。大于 50MB 的文本/二进制文件返回错误并提示（视频因只读元数据不受此限）。
description_en: Read file contents. Supports text/images/videos/PDF/Jupyter notebooks/Office and document formats (docx/docm/dotx/doc, xlsx/xlsm/xltx/xltm/xls, pptx/pptm/potx/ppsx, odt/ods/odp/rtf; legacy .ppt is not supported). Office documents are converted to Markdown with embedded images and video bodies extracted; artifacts are written to .moss/analysis/<file-hash>/ (project: <cwd>/.moss/analysis; system scope: global ~/.moss/analysis), and the Markdown carries the read paths of images/videos at their corresponding positions. Video files return basic info plus container metadata (duration/resolution/codec; mp4/mov/webm/mkv and more). Supports full read (with line numbers), exact line-range read (offset+limit), and indentation mode (extract a complete code block based on indentation). Supports batch reading of multiple files. Auto-detects UTF-8/GBK encodings and minified files. Text/binary files larger than 50MB return an error with a hint (videos are exempt since only metadata is read).

offset.description_en: Precise mode: starting line number (1-based); indentation mode: anchor line number

mode.description_en: Read mode: full=entire file with line numbers (default), precise=exact range via offset+limit, indentation=extract a complete code block based on indentation
